title: Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT): Evidence-Based Text Generation via a Closed-Loop Retrieve--Reflect--Revise Pipeline on Edge LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23311v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent outputs that lack source support or conflict with local operational constraints. We introduce Self-Reflective Chain-of-Thought (SRCoT), a modular architecture that organizes generation as a closed Retrieve--Reflect--Revise loop. SRCoT separates environment state, persistent knowledge, accumulated experience, and short-term memory into provenance-labeled stores. BM25 retrieval supplies local context; subsequent passes expose intermediate drafts, missing-information markers, follow-up queries, and optional claim--evidence mappings. These artifacts inform retrieval, revision, clarification, or abstention decisions. We examine the architecture through qualitative, trace-based case studies in two fully synthetic settings: emergency medical services and Munich-Sim, an emergency-operations simulation. translated_title: 自反思思维链（SRCoT）：基于边缘大语言模型的闭环“检索—反思—修订”流水线实现有证据支撑的文本生成
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够生成流畅的输出，但这些输出可能缺乏来源支持，或与本地运行约束相冲突。我们提出了自反思思维链（SRCoT），这是一种模块化架构，将生成过程组织为一个闭环的“检索—反思—修订”循环。SRCoT将环境状态、持久知识、积累经验和短期记忆分离到带有来源标签的存储中。BM25检索提供局部上下文；后续处理轮次会呈现中间草稿、缺失信息标记、后续查询以及可选的“论断—证据”映射，这些产物为检索、修订、澄清或弃答决策提供依据。我们通过在两个完全合成的场景中进行基于轨迹的定性案例研究来考察该架构：急救医疗服务和Munich-Sim（一个应急行动模拟环境）。在配备128 GB内存的Apple M4系列笔记本电脑上本地运行的原型展示了带有来源标签的数据……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出自反思思维链（SRCoT）架构，通过闭环“检索—反思—修订”流程和带来源标签的多层存储机制，使边缘设备上的大语言模型能够生成有证据支撑、可追溯的文本。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SRCoT, a modular closed-loop Retrieve–Reflect–Revise architecture with provenance-labeled memory stores that enables evidence-grounded, traceable text generation on edge LLMs.
